title: Utah Files Felony Charges Against Kalshi, Co-Founders Over Sports Bets
summary: The state says an undercover agent placed a dozen sports wagers on Kalshi, a day after the CFTC sued Utah to block its enforcement actions.

title: Treasury Sanctions 11 Over North Korean IT Worker Scheme That Moved Millions in Crypto
summary: Two Russian nationals converted more than $5 million in crypto for North Korean networks, according to OFAC, which listed their wallets.

title: Morning Minute: Hedge Funds Left the BTC ETF Trade and Sovereign Wealth Stepped In
summary: Now the BTC ETFs have flipped green for the month after $400M+ inflows this week, setting the stage for a big November.

title: Justin Sun's HTX Agrees to Leave UK in Settlement With Financial Watchdog
summary: The FCA says the Justin Sun-linked exchange will no longer target UK consumers, ending its first case against a crypto firm over marketing.

title: Polygon Extends Its Stablecoin Payments Infrastructure to Solana
summary: The expansion gives Solana businesses one integration to connect bank funding, embedded wallets, cross-chain transfers and global payouts, with cross-border firm Kira among the first adopters.

title: Walmart Blocks Its Stock From OKX-ICE Tokenized Trading Venue
summary: Walmart, Eli Lilly, Cigna, Carniva,l and Arcos Dorados objected to trading of their shares on the planned OKX-ICE tokenized stock venue, bringing the total to 38.

title: Hyperliquid's HYPE Jumps 13% as NYSE Owner ICE Moves to Bring Its Perpetual Futures to the US
summary: Intercontinental Exchange signed a deal with Trade[XYZ] to launch regulated perpetual futures built on Hyperliquid in the United States, sending HYPE soaring.

title: 4M Bitcoin Bought Above $85K Could Cap Recovery: Glassnode
summary: Bitcoin is trading close to the average price paid by U.S. spot ETF holders, a day after the Federal Reserve held rates steady.

title: $11 Billion in Bitcoin Options Expire Tomorrow—Here's What It Means
summary: A third of Deribit's Bitcoin options settle Friday, a day after the Fed held rates with two officials voting to hike. Here's why that matters for Bitcoin's price.

title: Crypto Spends $176 Million on Midterms, But Only 13% of Voters See It as a Priority
summary: Only 13% of Americans say a candidate’s support for crypto growth is very important, according to a survey conducted by Ipsos for the DeFi Education Fund, even as the industry spends heavily on next week’s elections.

title: Polymarket Pauses Trading as Prediction Market Investigates Security Incident
summary: Polymarket restricted trading and paused relayer actions as users report funds leaving their accounts. A suspected attacker wallet holds about $2.65 million in POL, per Arkham data.

title: Hackers Publish Work Details of 41,000 Homeland Security Employees
summary: A hacktivist group says it took names, titles, and phone numbers of 41,000-plus DHS staff from a login system.

title: Chrome Can Now Pull Details From Your Gmail to Fill Out Web Forms
summary: Chrome's new autofill uses Google's Gemini AI to search your Gmail for order numbers, tracking details, and flight bookings and fill them into web forms. It is rolling out in the U.S.

title: Coinbase Swings to $719 Million Q3 Profit on Crypto Gains
summary: Coinbase reported third-quarter net income of $719 million, driven largely by gains on its crypto holdings, as revenue held flat at $1.22 billion.

title: Binance Drained of $5.5 Billion in Suspected Hack, Tether and Circle Freeze $1.8 Billion
summary: An on-chain tally puts the suspected Binance drain at $5.57 billion across three blockchains, as Tether and Circle froze $1.8 billion.

title: Binance Hacker Hunts for Exit Ramps as DeFi Exchanges Pause Markets
summary: Etherscan records show wallets tied to the suspected Binance hack swapping freezable stablecoins for Ethereum on decentralized exchanges.
